name: Proton Mail Bridge
description: Local mail server with Proton login and mail-client credentials
author: spotty
help:
Optional local mail-server service

In the Store, find Proton Mail Bridge under Server-side installations. Click Install to enable the service, then Settings to sign in. This is a local IMAP/SMTP server packaged with Spotty, not a search trigger. No trigger word or shortcut is registered.

If already connected, Settings shows the generated Bridge password, mail username and IMAP/SMTP host, ports and TLS settings for a new mail client. Sign out disconnects that account; you can sign back in from the same window. Closing Settings keeps Bridge running.

Requires a paid Proton Mail plan and a working unlocked Linux keyring. Credentials are entered only in the native GTK4/libadwaita window. No system-wide package installation is needed.
